graph_conditioning: If a is a fixed function of graph or allowed training statistics, the same algebra holds conditionally on those statistics. Scalar conditioning redistributes step size between groups; it creates no new reachable direction. No specified distinct graph construction has been established.
linear_coordinate_identity: For a valid fixed invertible linear gauge phiPrime=T phi and Lprime(phiPrime)=L(T^-1 phiPrime), Euclidean SGD maps exactly to phiNext=phi-eta T^-1 T^-T grad_phi L, for the declared same objective and normalization.
pooled_first_order_response: With identical initial functions, the same examples/masks and same per-member normalized supervised objective, the differential of a fixed probability mean equals the differential from the mean private metric/kernel (plus the common shared contribution if trained). Mean-loss autodiff normalization adds its common known factor; coefficients must match it.
proved_gauge_used: Per valid private owner, Rprime=aR; Sprime=S/a; Bprime=B; constant real a!=0. Only this established scalar transformation is applied to the actual fast-vector architecture.
reciprocal_pair: For a=exp(t) and exp(-t), mean R and S metric coefficients both equal cosh(2t); the unchanged B coefficient is1. Increased mean private step scale is a confound unless the single/group-rate controls match it.
scope_caveats: No arbitrary GL, orthogonal, diagonal or per-feature transformation is assumed valid in the actual architecture.
No Adam invariance claim: coordinatewise moments, epsilon and state matter.
Parameter-coordinate regularization can break invariant-objective assumptions.
State-dependent or dynamically rebalanced gauges require their derivatives/transport and are not covered by fixedT.
This is exact-arithmetic algebra, not a floating-point equality or predictive-result claim.
shared_backbone: At corresponding states the shared-backbone gradient is unchanged by a valid private gauge. An ensemble that later develops different functions may have a different aggregated backbone gradient; no whole-ensemble finite trajectory equivalence to one single is claimed.
sign_gauge: a=+1/-1 gives the identity metric, so it does not create ordinary-SGD functional trajectory diversity with matched masks and state.
tangent_kernel: At a common corresponding state K_a=a^-2 K_R+a^2 K_S+K_B. Right multiplication of J by an invertible coordinate matrix leaves its reachable output range unchanged.
